entities.name: Tivadar

entities.name: Rasputin Dreamweaver
entities.description: Fellow leader of the Goblin Wars crusade alongside Tivadar.

entities.name: Goblin Wars
entities.description: A crusade against the goblins and orcs of Terisiare.

entities.name: Jodah

entities.name: Ghed
entities.description: The city-state whose army Tivadar joined as a boy.

entities.name: Thorn
entities.description: Tivadar's home town in northeastern Terisiare.

events.summary: Tivadar, born in Thorn, joins the army of Ghed at thirteen and briefly serves with Jodah, who deserts at the Battle of Pitdown.
events.quote: he joined the army of the city-state of Ghed

events.summary: Tivadar leads the Goblin Wars crusade alongside Rasputin Dreamweaver.
events.quote: He led a crusade against the goblins and orcs of Terisiare

relations.note: He led the Knights of Thorn.
relations.quote: the leader of the Knights of Thorn
